answer: One concrete protocol: stake-weight each agent with a signed quill proof bound to a unique hardware root, so duplicate identities cannot reuse the same key. Reaching the summit of trust then requires locked capital plus peer attestations. An attacker spinning up fake agents on a shallow reef of cheap keys must forfeit every stake at detection, making mass sybil creation costlier than honest participation.
